title: SyntheticGroundTruth
description: Known-answer ground truth for the synthetic debug demo. Used by the assertion harness to compare estimated outputs against exact analytical values.

_comment.description: Human-readable comment for documentation purposes (ignored by validators)

seed.description: RNG seed used to generate this ground truth

trajectories.description: Analytical ground truth for each trajectory defined in scene.json

camera_projections.description: Analytical 2D projections of each trajectory onto each camera

expected_assets.description: Structural expectations for the generated asset bundle

position.description: Exact world-frame position at this timestamp

id.description: Must match a trajectory id in scene.json

sample_points.description: Analytical sample positions at known timestamps. Harness interpolates between these.

total_arc_length_m.description: Total path length in metres (used to verify trajectory generator output)

pixel.description: Exact 2D projection [x_px, y_px] in the camera image plane (before any discretisation)

visible.description: Whether the projected point falls within the camera resolution

camera_id.description: Must match a camera id in cameras.json

trajectory_id.description: Must match a trajectory id in scene.json
The scene trajectory this tracklet should correspond to

min_point_count.description: Minimum number of triangulated points expected in the tracklet

max_position_error_m.description: Maximum allowed RMS position error against analytical trajectory (metres)

max_time_error_us.description: Maximum allowed timestamp error per point (microseconds)

event_frame_count_per_camera.description: Expected number of event-frame-2d assets per camera

derived_from_dag_closed.description: Assertion: all derived_from references resolve to known asset IDs in the bundle
